articles.summary: MERRILLVILLE, Ind. – The board of directors of NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) today declared a quarterly common stock dividend payment of $0.30 cents per share, payable November 20, 2026, to stockholders of record at the close of business on October 30, 2026.
articles.title: NiSource declares common stock dividend

articles.summary: MERRILLVILLE, Ind. - NiSource Inc. (NYSE: NI) today announced, on a GAAP basis, net income available to common shareholders for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 of $45.5 million, or $0.09 of earnings per diluted share, compared to net income available to common shareholders of $102.2 million, or $0.22 of earnings per diluted share, for the same period of 2025. For the six months ended June 30, 2026, on a GAAP basis, NiSource's net income available to common shareholders was $556.2 million, or $1.15 diluted earnings per share, compared to net income available to common shareholders of $577.0 million, or $1.22 diluted earnings per share, for the same period of 2025.
articles.title: NiSource announces second quarter results

articles.summary:
As northern Indiana continues to attract significant economic investment and energy demand growth, one thing remains unchanged: our commitment to protecting customers while supporting the region's future.  

That's why NIPSCO Generation LLC is now NiSource Generation Company LLC (GenCo).  

The new name better reflects the company's role within the broader NiSource enterprise while clearly distinguishing it from NIPSCO's traditional utility operations. Importantly, this is a name change only, not a change in strategy.
articles.title: NiSource Generation Company: A new name that reflects a proven customer-first strategy
